title: Make rerun final publication transactional
summary: Publish rerun media, canonical pipeline evidence, subtitle companions, and completion evidence through one manifest-backed recoverable transaction.
reason: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W10P-002, AUDIT-FIND-W10P-003, and the directly coupled abandoned completion-mutex defect AUDIT-FIND-W10P-005.
behavior_before: Non-overlap publication moved media without companions or completion evidence; replace-final moved new media before companions and did not restore the old final on companion failure.
behavior_after: Final publication stages and verifies media plus companions on the destination volume, records transaction state, commits completion evidence last, and either completes coherently or restores the prior final state with deterministic restart recovery.
tests_added: Non-overlap publication commits media, canonical pipeline sidecar, subtitle companions, and exactly one completion row.
Fault injection at every staging and commit boundary restores the previous final-library state and retains verified rerun output.
Completion append I/O failure rolls the publication back; committed completion replay is idempotent.
Abandoned completion mutex ownership is recovered without dropping the first append.
Distinct-process hard-kill recovery rolls back partial commit or finalizes a completion-backed commit deterministically.
Representative generated MKV replacement preserves source SHA-256 and verifies final video, audio, duration, subtitle sidecar, pipeline evidence, and completion evidence.
manual_validation: All seven rerun PowerShell wrappers passed, including auto destination, cooperative stop, nested config, plan-only, transactional publication, recovery, and source identity.

The publication transaction wrapper passed both synthetic fault injection and -RepresentativeMedia using disposable FFmpeg-generated source, prior-final, and replacement MKVs; source SHA-256 remained unchanged.

Pending-publish safety, transaction fault injection, encode publish-order split, and contract-schema checks passed; risky-file, lifecycle-map, test-inventory, architecture, naming, active-document, Ruff, compileall, mypy, and focused Python checks passed.

Focused process-rerun validation passed 35 tests with three known unrelated pending-publish contract failures deselected; focused network-rerun validation passed 48 tests with one known unrelated pending-publish projection failure deselected.
The reliability wrapper passed architecture, native cleanup, runtime-state hygiene, and sidecar safety before the established unrelated WebView static-asset assertion.

A full Windows release build with -Zip -Verify -IncludeTests ran for 973 seconds. Package policy, environment, Tauri prerequisites, tool integration, and end-to-end smoke passed; aggregate verification exited 1 only on established WebView static-asset, dependency-cycle, generated/status-document, tracked-office-document, and unrelated Ruff baselines.

A fresh exact release-policy copy matched 14 included implementation/test/document paths by SHA-256. Inside it, representative publication transaction, auto-destination, and the exact Python queue-projection test passed; TEST_SUITE_SUBSYSTEM_INVENTORY.md is intentionally excluded by release policy.
rollback_plan: Revert the publication transaction helper, restart recovery hook, completion-mutex recovery, focused tests, generated artifacts, documentation, and packet metadata together. Preserve source media and any transaction manifests or same-volume backups until deterministic rollback evidence is reviewed.
notes: High-risk final-library mutation boundary. Source media mutation is forbidden. Validation used only generated disposable media and sidecars; no live library, source-media mutation, or lifecycle start/stop occurred. Pending-publish drain behavior is unchanged. Python impact: rerun queue projection now exposes publication transaction identity, manifest path, and state as first-class evidence. Existing overlapping changes in the touched rerun, inventory, reliability, Python, and documentation files were preserved. Known unrelated worktree baselines remain outside this packet: three stale summaries, DOC005 at the active audit BASELINE reference, the mediapipeline.core.processes to mediapipeline.core.queue dependency cycle, two rename-test Ruff B023 findings, the WebView static-asset reliability assertion, four pending-publish rerun/projection test failures, and package/generated-document drift. Immutable audit evidence remained read-only.
